explanation: Only fires at D1 when the previous trial was rewarded in S1 after choosing a1. It hits about 10 on the first such reward after an unrewarded trial early in the episode (trials 0-30), then drops by about 1-2 with each further reward in a row (10, 8, 7, 6, down to 0 in long streaks), is weaker later in the episode (about 4-7 near trial 40-75, 0-2 near trial 80-95), and is 0 at every GO and D2 step and after any no-reward, any reward reached in S2, or any a2 choice.
